newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech blue chips post modest gains, PX50 closes up.
newsitem.headline: Czech blue chips post modest gains, PX50 closes up.

text.p: Czech blue chip shares posted modest gains in heavier trading on the Prague Stock Exchange on Monday, as the PX50 index rose 2.7 points, or 0.51 percent, to 535.6.
SPT Telecom and Komercni Banka led the index higher firming 10 crowns and 30 crowns respectively, while savings bank Ceska Sporitelna ratcheted up eight crowns to 279.
"SPT is currently strongly promoting itself with road shows in the U.S. and U.K....thus the upward trend could continue," Investmentbank Austria said in a report.
Engineering concern Skoda did not fare as well, dropping 17 crowns to close at 936.
Earlier in the day the PSE released data showing Skoda posted a first quarter gross profit of 72.3 million crowns. Comparative figures were not immediately available.

Overall, 105 issues gained ground on the session, while 60 lost and 46 were unchanged. Total volume, boosted mainly by direct trades, was very heavy at 2.73 million shares on turnover of 1.55 billion crowns.
